- New error code PQ-E3239 (QUOTA_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

[d0292] PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E4712 SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: work queue full`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
The internal work queue of the snapshotter is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `snapshotter.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `compactor: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the compactor use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

- A deployment where nodes have different settings

Set `compactor.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

# PQ-E3441 ACKTRACKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.2

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the acktracker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A slow disk
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `acktracker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# PQ-E2400 SPOOL_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The spool gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix

# PQ-E2602 COORDINATOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: work queue full`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The internal work queue of the coordinator is full, new tasks are rejected.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Add worker threads or increase `coordinator.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

# PaderQueue 2.0 release notes

Released on 2022-04-11.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## New features

- New option `compactor.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `partitioner.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E2051 (COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

- New option `spool.compression`: compression codec that the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments uses for stored or transferred data.

- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4708 (SCHEDULER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `coordinator.compression`: compression codec that the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers uses for stored or transferred data.

# `metrics.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `8` |
| Available since | 2.2 |
| Component | metrics |

## Notes

Changes to `metrics.max_retries` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[metrics]
max_retries = 8
```

# Runbook: spool troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `spool` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_spool_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `spool.max_connections`
- `spool.max_retries`
- `spool.enabled`
- `spool.compression`
- `spool.threshold_percent`
- `spool.batch_size`
- `spool.log_level`
- `spool.interval_s`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

**Log message:** `auth: retries exhausted`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
The auth gave up after reaching the configured maximum number of retry attempts.

- Too small limits for the current load

Check the logs for the underlying failure first. If the failures are transient, increase `auth.max_retries`.

Size of the in-memory buffer used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues, in bytes.

[d0236] PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the broker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `broker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

# Postmortem INC-2025-175: chat-relay degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 90 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `chat-relay`

## Summary
During the incident, `chat-relay` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2617 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `chat-relay` fired.
- T+22: On-call engineer found PQ-E2617 in the broker logs.
- T+45: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+90: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2617.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# `spool.interval_s` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|

- T+105: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+210: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4572.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0512] PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E2771 DLQ_OPERATION_TIMEOUT

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `dlq: operation timeout`
**Severity:** critical
**First introduced in:** 2.3

## What it means
An operation of the dlq did not complete within the configured timeout.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Check network latency and load on the involved nodes. For slow but healthy clusters, increase `dlq.timeout_ms`.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `snapshotter.enabled`: turns the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues on or off.

- New option `auth.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the authentication module that validates client tokens waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Duplicate processing in `fraud-scoring`

## Summary
During the incident, `fraud-scoring` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2051 repeatedly.

- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E2051 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team paused the noisiest producer.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2051.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0236] PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3221 BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: buffer exhausted`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
The in-memory buffer of the broker is full and new data is rejected.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Reduce the incoming rate or increase `broker.buffer_bytes`. Also check whether downstream processing is stuck.

Two nodes of the replicator use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

- Too many tenants on one node

Set `replicator.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

# Runbook: compactor troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `compactor` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_compactor_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `compactor.timeout_ms`
- `compactor.enabled`
- `compactor.interval_s`
- `compactor.batch_size`
- `compactor.worker_threads`
- `compactor.queue_capacity`
- `compactor.compression`
- `compactor.log_level`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

[d0164] PQ-E1441 COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E1441 COORDINATOR_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `coordinator: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the coordinator use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A deployment where nodes have different settings

## How to fix
Set `coordinator.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

[d0227] PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

# Postmortem INC-2025-126: chat-relay degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 210 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `chat-relay`

## Summary
During the incident, `chat-relay` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E4895 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `chat-relay` fired.
- T+52: On-call engineer found PQ-E4895 in the broker logs.
- T+105: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+210: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E4895.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# `acktracker.enabled`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Turns the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed on or off.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | boolean |
| Default | `true` |
| Available since | 3.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.enabled` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
enabled = true
```

# PQ-E3249 ACKTRACKER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `acktracker: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** warning
**First introduced in:** 3.1

## What it means
The acktracker refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `acktracker.max_connections`.

# `acktracker.interval_s`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `30` |

The default works for most deployments. Change `acktracker.interval_s` only if you observe problems with the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed, for example in the metrics dashboard.

```toml
[acktracker]

```

# Runbook: acktracker troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `acktracker` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_acktracker_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `acktracker.timeout_ms`
- `acktracker.max_retries`
- `acktracker.buffer_bytes`
- `acktracker.max_connections`
- `acktracker.batch_size`
- `acktracker.interval_s`
- `acktracker.enabled`
- `acktracker.queue_capacity`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

# PQ-E4007 BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `broker: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.0

## What it means
Two nodes of the broker use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Set `broker.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

# Runbook: coordinator troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

## Health check

2. Look at the `paderqueue_coordinator_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings

- `coordinator.worker_threads`
- `coordinator.max_connections`
- `coordinator.buffer_bytes`
- `coordinator.queue_capacity`
- `coordinator.threshold_percent`
- `coordinator.enabled`
- `coordinator.compression`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

# Postmortem INC-2024-147: search-indexer degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 40 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `search-indexer`

## Summary
During the incident, `search-indexer` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2051 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `search-indexer` fired.
- T+10: On-call engineer found PQ-E2051 in the broker logs.
- T+20: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+40: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a failing disk on one node.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2051.
- Add an alert for this error code.

[d0227] PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

# PQ-E2470 SNAPSHOTTER_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: component disabled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
A request needed the snapshotter, but the snapshotter is switched off.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `snapshotter.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

# PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

[d0192] PaderQueue 2.0 release notes (type: changelog | version: 2.0)

# PaderQueue 2.0 release notes

Released on 2022-04-11.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## New features

- New option `compactor.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `partitioner.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E2051 (COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

- New option `spool.compression`: compression codec that the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments uses for stored or transferred data.

- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4708 (SCHEDULER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `coordinator.compression`: compression codec that the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers uses for stored or transferred data.

# Postmortem INC-2024-136: report-builder degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `report-builder`

## Summary
During the incident, `report-builder` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2758 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `report-builder` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E2758 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2758.
- Add an alert for this error code.

If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

# Postmortem INC-2025-140: checkout-service degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `checkout-service`

## Summary
During the incident, `checkout-service` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E1019 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `checkout-service` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E1019 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a configuration change during a deployment.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E1019.
- Add an alert for this error code.

- New option `acktracker.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

- New error code PQ-E3828 (METRICS_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E3239 (QUOTA_COMPONENT_DISABLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `coordinator.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers starts throttling.

- New option `coordinator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers.

- New option `dlq.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue.

```
pq snapshot create <name> [flags]
```

```
pq snapshot create orders --timeout
```

## New features

- New option `auth.batch_size`: number of messages the authentication module that validates client tokens processes together in one batch.

- New option `compactor.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `auth.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `ingress.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST.

- New option `metrics.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E4590 (SNAPSHOTTER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `auth.log_level`: log verbosity of the authentication module that validates client tokens.

- New option `scheduler.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

[d0227] PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED (type: error | version: 4.x)

# PQ-E3177 SCHEDULER_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 3.2

## What it means
The scheduler refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `scheduler.max_connections`.

retrieved.chunk_text:
[d0870] PaderQueue 1.2 release notes (type: changelog | version: 1.2)

New error code PQ-E1565 (COORDINATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message. - New option `compactor.log_level`: log verbosity of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `quota.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

- New option `quota.enabled`: turns the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant on or off.

- New option `spool.batch_size`: number of messages the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments processes together in one batch.

- New option `partitioner.compression`: compression codec that the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written uses for stored or transferred data.

- New option `snapshotter.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues starts throttling.

- New error code PQ-E4712 (SNAPSHOTTER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `retention.log_level`: log verbosity of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

- New option `coordinator.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers, in bytes.

[d0804] Postmortem INC-2024-214 (type: incident | version: 4.x)

# Postmortem INC-2024-214: inventory-sync degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 210 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `inventory-sync`

## Summary
During the incident, `inventory-sync` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E3792 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `inventory-sync` fired.
- T+52: On-call engineer found PQ-E3792 in the broker logs.
- T+105: The team rolled back the last client deployment.
- T+210: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a configuration change during a deployment.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E3792.
- Add an alert for this error code.

The retention is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `retention.threshold_percent`.

# PaderQueue 2.0 release notes

Released on 2022-04-11.

This is a major release. Read the section on changed defaults before upgrading.

## New features

- New option `compactor.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

- New option `partitioner.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written, in bytes.

- New error code PQ-E2051 (COMPACTOR_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New option `acktracker.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

- New option `spool.compression`: compression codec that the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments uses for stored or transferred data.

- New error code PQ-E3575 (COORDINATOR_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4426 (SCHEDULER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E4708 (SCHEDULER_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `coordinator.compression`: compression codec that the consumer group coordinator that assigns partitions to consumers uses for stored or transferred data.

# PQ-E4020 SPOOL_CODEC_MISMATCH

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: codec mismatch`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.2

## What it means
Two nodes of the spool use different compression codecs and cannot read each other's data.

## Common causes
- A sudden spike in traffic
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Set `spool.compression` to the same value on all nodes, then restart them one after another.

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Usage level in percent at which the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time starts throttling.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer (percent) |
| Default | `75` |

Changes to `scheduler.threshold_percent` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
threshold_percent = 75
```

# Runbook: scheduler troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `scheduler` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_scheduler_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `scheduler.log_level`
- `scheduler.buffer_bytes`
- `scheduler.queue_capacity`
- `scheduler.threshold_percent`
- `scheduler.batch_size`
- `scheduler.max_connections`
- `scheduler.interval_s`
- `scheduler.max_retries`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

# `replicator.worker_threads`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | replicator |
| Unit | threads |
| Default changed | in 3.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `replicator.worker_threads` only if you observe problems with the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[replicator]
worker_threads = 1
```

[d0700] PaderQueue 1.0 release notes (type: changelog | version: 1.0)

- New option `metrics.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics. - New error code PQ-E3221 (BROKER_BUFFER_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `broker.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues.

- New error code PQ-E4582 (RETENTION_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `retention.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

- New error code PQ-E1019 (INGRESS_THROTTLED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2617 (DLQ_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `scheduler.queue_capacity`: maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

- New option `broker.compression`: compression codec that the broker process that accepts messages from producers and routes them to queues uses for stored or transferred data.

- New error code PQ-E3557 (REPLICATOR_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `ingress.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST waits for a response before the operation fails.

# PQ-E3108 SPOOL_CONNECTION_LIMIT_REACHED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `spool: connection limit reached`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.1

## What it means
The spool refused a new connection because the connection limit is reached.

## Common causes
- A long garbage collection pause
- Too small limits for the current load

## How to fix
Check for connection leaks in clients (connections that are never closed). If the load is legitimate, increase `spool.max_connections`.

# Runbook: compactor troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the compactor that merges old log segments and removes superseded messages.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `compactor` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_compactor_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `compactor.timeout_ms`
- `compactor.enabled`
- `compactor.interval_s`
- `compactor.batch_size`
- `compactor.worker_threads`
- `compactor.queue_capacity`
- `compactor.compression`
- `compactor.log_level`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

# Postmortem INC-2024-128: shipping-tracker degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Delayed messages for `shipping-tracker`

## Summary
During the incident, `shipping-tracker` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E2622 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `shipping-tracker` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E2622 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team temporarily moved traffic to the secondary cluster.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a new client version with a retry bug.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E2622.
- Add an alert for this error code.

A request needed the snapshotter, but the snapshotter is switched off.

- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

Enable the component by setting `snapshotter.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

# `retention.timeout_ms` (PaderQueue 2.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 2.x.

Time in milliseconds that the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period waits for a response before the operation fails.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | ms |

## Notes

Changes to `retention.timeout_ms` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
timeout_ms = 10000
```

# Runbook: partitioner troubleshooting

> Operations runbook

This runbook covers the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

## Health check
1. Run `pq node describe <node> --output json` and check the `partitioner` section.
2. Look at the `paderqueue_partitioner_errors_total` metric.

## Relevant settings
- `partitioner.buffer_bytes`
- `partitioner.batch_size`
- `partitioner.queue_capacity`
- `partitioner.max_retries`
- `partitioner.compression`
- `partitioner.interval_s`
- `partitioner.enabled`
- `partitioner.log_level`

## Escalation
If the problem persists for more than 30 minutes, escalate to the platform team.

# Postmortem INC-2025-206: user-activity degraded

> Internal incident report

**Duration:** 12 minutes
**Impact:** Failed requests in `user-activity`

## Summary
During the incident, `user-activity` could not process messages reliably. The PaderQueue logs on the affected nodes
showed error PQ-E3891 repeatedly.

## Timeline
- T+0: Alerts for `user-activity` fired.
- T+3: On-call engineer found PQ-E3891 in the broker logs.
- T+6: The team restarted the affected nodes.
- T+12: Service recovered.

## Root cause
The immediate trigger was a marketing campaign that tripled traffic.

## Follow-up
- The workaround is not a permanent fix. Apply the fix recommended in the error catalogue for PQ-E3891.
- Add an alert for this error code.

# PQ-E2470 SNAPSHOTTER_COMPONENT_DISABLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `snapshotter: component disabled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 1.0

## What it means
A request needed the snapshotter, but the snapshotter is switched off.

## Common causes
- Network problems between nodes
- A consumer that stopped reading

## How to fix
Enable the component by setting `snapshotter.enabled` to `true` and restart the node.

# PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

# PQ-E4708 SCHEDULER_THROTTLED

> Error catalogue, PaderQueue 4.x

**Log message:** `scheduler: throttled`
**Severity:** error
**First introduced in:** 2.0

## What it means
The scheduler is throttling requests because usage is above the configured threshold.

## Common causes
- A misconfigured client
- Too many tenants on one node

## How to fix
Throttling protects the node. Add capacity or reduce load. As a last resort, raise `scheduler.threshold_percent`.

# PaderQueue 1.1 release notes

Released on 2021-07-19.

## New features

- New option `scheduler.batch_size`: number of messages the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time processes together in one batch.

- New option `metrics.max_connections`: maximum number of simultaneous client connections accepted by the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics.

- New option `dlq.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the dead-letter handler that moves undeliverable messages to the dead-letter queue waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New option `partitioner.max_retries`: maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

- New error code PQ-E1616 (PARTITIONER_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.worker_threads`: number of worker threads used by the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes.

- New option `retention.threshold_percent`: usage level in percent at which the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period starts throttling.

**Log message:** `compactor: work queue full`

The internal work queue of the compactor is full, new tasks are rejected.

- Network problems between nodes
- Too small limits for the current load

Add worker threads or increase `compactor.queue_capacity`. A queue that stays full usually means the component is too slow.

[d0406] PaderQueue 3.0 release notes (type: changelog | version: 3.0)

- New option `metrics.log_level`: log verbosity of the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics. - New option `acktracker.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed.

- New option `quota.interval_s`: interval in seconds between two background runs of the quota manager that limits the throughput per tenant.

- New error code PQ-E4007 (BROKER_CODEC_MISMATCH) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2154 (QUOTA_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E3891 (COMPACTOR_WORK_QUEUE_FULL) with a clearer log message.

- New option `replicator.timeout_ms`: time in milliseconds that the replicator that copies partitions to follower nodes waits for a response before the operation fails.

- New error code PQ-E2758 (RETENTION_OPERATION_TIMEOUT) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E2995 (QUOTA_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New error code PQ-E1563 (SNAPSHOTTER_RETRIES_EXHAUSTED) with a clearer log message.

- New option `metrics.compression`: compression codec that the metrics exporter that exposes Prometheus metrics uses for stored or transferred data.

- New option `ingress.buffer_bytes`: size of the in-memory buffer used by the HTTP ingress gateway that accepts messages over REST, in bytes.
